test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the production of wheat (in 1000 tonnes) in India over the years. What was the percentage decline in the production of wheat from 2013 to 2014?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0384d39d6ddbf1badf90442fac67af35a4a2ef506187b148b1d27c69d49876a9.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

According to the question,

2013 = 100

2014 = 75

Decreased = 100 - 75 = 25

% = 25/100 × 100 = 25%

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
